constraints.text: Do not add spoken or sung lines.

references.description: The low engine rumble, authorized as the car's voice reference.
references.retention_details: The low engine rumble is used only as the car's voice timbre; it is not treated as a complete soundtrack or as spoken dialogue.

claims.text: The car pulls forward out of the dark.
The audio reference is described as a low engine rumble.
A thin ambient sheen catches the front bodywork before the car emerges, and the front grille and headlamp housing become legible as it advances.

description.text: Near-total darkness presses in from every edge of the scene. The car is present only as a faint, low silhouette, its outline barely separable from the surrounding black. A dim ambient sheen touches one thin edge of the front bodywork, revealing the faintest suggestion of metal before the shadow closes again. The engine's low rumble sits under the scene, felt as much as heard, and gradually deepens without becoming loud. Nothing else in the scene is legible; the darkness holds the car at the threshold of visibility. The air itself seems dark, with no visible horizon, ground plane, or secondary object to give scale. The car's front is angled slightly toward the viewer, but that angle is inferred only from the thin highlight traveling along the bodywork. The rumble has a soft, mechanical texture, low enough to blur into vibration, and it rises in small degrees as if the vehicle is gathering itself.
Darkness dominates the scene; the car is barely a silhouette.
The low rumble starts beneath the scene.
A narrow highlight traces the front edge, then fades.

The car pulls forward out of the dark, its front emerging slowly into a dim wash of ambient light. The silhouette gains weight as the bodywork moves closer to readability, though the edges remain wrapped in shadow. The forward motion is steady and controlled, a slow creep rather than a surge. The engine note steadies with the advance, a continuous low pull that matches the vehicle's measured pace. The surrounding darkness stays dense, so the car appears to bring its own narrow pocket of visibility with it. The front bodywork is broad and low, and the dim light grazes its upper surfaces without revealing color or fine trim. Each increment of movement makes the shape more certain while leaving the rear and sides unreadable.
The front enters the dim ambient wash as the car advances.
The engine note settles into a steady pull.
The silhouette firms up, though the edges remain dark.

The car's front resolves further out of shadow. The grille and the housing around the headlamp become legible as the remaining veil of darkness falls away, though the light stays dim and the rest of the vehicle remains partly obscured. The vehicle continues its steady creep, holding the same low, even engine tone. The front bodywork catches a faint sheen along its upper edge, enough to define the shape without turning the scene bright. The car is now readable as a solid form advancing through the dark, with the engine rumble still carrying beneath it. The grille's horizontal bars and the headlamp's recessed rim are distinct only at close range, their details emerging one by one rather than all at once. The darkness behind the car remains complete, so the vehicle seems to detach from it as it moves.
The grille and headlamp housing emerge one detail at a time.
The rumble holds an even low tone.
The car keeps creeping forward, the front now fully detached from the shadow.

soundscape: A continuous low engine rumble with a faint ambient hush.
